d:
The Drop crew dives into the return of Patrick Reed in 2027. Reed earned his PGA Tour card by finishing in the top 10 of the DP World Tour Ranking after the season wrapped up in Dubai last week.
Patrick Reed is returning to the Tour where he has nine wins; how much of a threat will players see him as?
The DROP is a weekly show that highlights the PGA Tour lifestyle inside and outside the ropes, telling the unique stories of the game's top names, as well as the up-and-coming stars on Tour.
